title: The Woman at the Well
reflectionQuestion: The woman felt left out by everyone, until Jesus truly saw her and was kind. I wonder how it feels to know that Jesus sees you, and loves every part of you?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Life, John 4). Fills freed ID 1889. The 'Jesus sees you' room -- for a child who feels left out / unseen / invisible. WATCH-ITEM: the five-husbands detail is OMITTED entirely; rendered gently as 'Jesus knew everything about her... even the things she felt ashamed of, and STILL he was kind / looked at her with nothing but love.' She is the left-out outsider (comes alone in the heat); Jesus crosses the social line to see + value her; she runs to tell the whole town. 'Living water' = a gladness deep inside that never runs dry. Soft close ('invisible'). VOICE_NOAH_PATIENT (a warm FEMALE voice Adam loves -- ideal tender fit for a 'you are truly seen' story; female voice for a woman-centered story).
